description: This file is a Go source file that generates provider code for oEmbed providers, specifically supporting YouTube, by parsing a JSON file of provider data and creating Go code from templates.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that reads providers.json, filters providers, extracts endpoints, and writes the generated code to providers_gen.go.

methods.name: extractEndpointsFromProvider
methods.description: Converts an oEmbedProvider object into a list of ProviderEndpoints with URL patterns.

methods.name: schemeToPattern
methods.description: Converts a URL scheme string into a compiled regular expression pattern.
